name: original
title: Original A/B monitoring
disturbance_mechanism: Middle-passage wind changes transfer speed and circulation direction

name: reversed
title: Original A/B, reversed wind
topology: Exact matched geometry and target cells
task: Same monitoring task, exact negative physical field
disturbance_mechanism: Reversal tests whether route use responds to disturbance direction

name: courtyards
title: Four-courtyard district
topology: Six staggered building blocks; intersecting streets
disturbance_mechanism: A circulating street flow changes the profitable order of four courtyard visits

name: exhaust
title: Industrial exhaust inspection
topology: Eight process blocks with offset gates
task: A sheltered staging site and five equipment inspection patches
disturbance_mechanism: Local exhaust jets disturb direct close inspection; lateral standoff views remain feasible

name: slalom
title: Serpentine street survey
topology: Four alternating long barriers and two corner blocks
task: Continuous narrow street segments rather than two target boxes
disturbance_mechanism: Opposite outer-street flows and a sheltered central street change survey order and approach direction

name: atrium
title: Atrium ring and gated courtyards
topology: Nested ring walls, two entrances, inner pavilion
task: Five patches inside and outside the ring
disturbance_mechanism: South and east entrance jets penalize direct transfers; the west inner route remains sheltered

name: freight
title: Freight-terminal service network
topology: Six offset cargo rows, two loading barriers and multiple cross-aisles
task: A sheltered staging bay and five service areas inside and around the racks
disturbance_mechanism: A central loading-lane jet penalizes direct transfers; exterior cross-aisles provide longer sheltered connections

name: perimeter
title: Shielded-facade perimeter patrol
topology: Large central structure, five detached annexes
task: Distributed perimeter samples along four facades
disturbance_mechanism: Corner jets and lee-side shelter alter where the robot can hold useful sensing positions

name: interchange
title: Three-branch infrastructure interchange
topology: Eight horizontal and vertical branch-separating blocks
task: Six critical junction and branch-end patches
disturbance_mechanism: Opposing horizontal branch flows penalize direct transfers; sheltered north and south branches create longer connections

name: distributed
title: Distributed mixed-priority survey
topology: Eight staggered islands with connected open loops
task: Six unequal target areas; many cells spread across the environment
disturbance_mechanism: A diagonal flow band intersects the large target and short connections, while edge loops provide shelter
